steps.label: Oils and fatty acids
steps.why: The liver of some fish is unusually rich in oil, which is why it is collected separately.
common_mistakes: Naming the fish without the product.
steps.memory_tip: Liver oils and omega-3 fatty acids.
steps.margin_note: Number them. Each is a tick.

steps.label: Fertiliser and isinglass
steps.why: Even waste fish and the air bladder have a use, which is what makes them by-products rather than waste.
common_mistakes: Leaving out what isinglass is made from.
steps.memory_tip: Fish guano is fertiliser; isinglass clears wine.
steps.margin_note: Say what each is used for.
lines: 3. Fish guano — fertiliser from waste fish.

insider_note: Four are asked, so give four, and say what each is used for — the use is what earns the mark.
